kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Originally رَأْيَة (raʔya), an instance noun of رَأَى (raʔā, “to see”), but "the Arabs prefer omitting [the hamza] ... and some say it has not been heard with ء (ʔ, “hamza”)." (Lane)
g: banner, ensign, an army's battle standard
